title: ASX MAXIMUM EDGE V8-I Data Gateway V3.2 Acceptance Specification
design_goal: Prove timestamped single-symbol repeatability on the Free plan without forcing multi-symbol batch behavior to pass.

tier_1.name: Single-symbol timestamp repeatability
pass_conditions: all 3 observations contain iTick source timestamp t
tier_1.promotion: Passes timestamp repeatability only. Execution authorization remains separate.

breadth.note: Run separately from Tier-1 on the Free plan.

pass_conditions: at least one quote/tick event is received
source timestamp t is present where applicable
websocket.promotion: Proves streaming capability only; does not grant execution authorization.

batch.failure_policy: Classify as unavailable/restricted; do not treat as failure of the single-symbol core feed.

hard_rules: Never infer freshness from gateway request latency.
Never convert provider errors into missing-timestamp observations.
Never use a secondary timestamp-less source to prove temporal freshness.
Never grant execution authorization from data integrity alone.
Never commit API credentials to source control.
